Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.view.graphical.controllers.game

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.view.graphical.controllers.game.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
The game controller contains the panel, overlay and end game controllers. It is used to propagate updates to the controllers.
